passive.name: Staggering Blow
passive.text: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.

spells.name: Dredge Line
spells.text: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. Colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, dealing magic damage. Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it.

spells.name: Titan's Wrath
spells.text: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield. While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Riptide
spells.text: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.

spells.name: Depth Charge
spells.text: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.

damage.value: Nautilus deals increased physical damage with his first Attack against a target, magic damage with Q, and sustained damage over time with W.

archetype.value: Nautilus is a tank vanguard who engages fights, controls enemies, and absorbs damage.

axis.value: Nautilus can start a short trade with his first Attack’s root or extend a trade while his W shield and damage over time persist.

winCondition.value: Nautilus wins by setting up picks, starting team fights, and absorbing damage around objectives.

spikes.at: R cooldown falls from 120 to 100 to 80 seconds
spikes.why: Nautilus can use Depth Charge more often as its cooldown decreases.

bait.why: When Nautilus spends Dredge Line, its pull is unavailable until the cooldown ends.
